🌈 [NEW] K-POP EDITION! ✨

Climb the rainbow stairs and find amazing worlds! Can you reach the top?

WHAT’S NEW?
• 🎤 K-POP THEME: New style, music, and stairs!
• 🎴 COLLECT CARDS: Collect cards from your favorite topics!
• 🌍 MANY WORLDS: K-Pop, 67 Memes, 99 Nights, Brainrots, Heaven, and more!

HOW TO PLAY?
• 🤝 TEAM UP: Work together to climb faster!
• 🚀 BOOST: Help friends and get bonuses!
• 🏆 REACH THE TOP: Unlock new card collections at the top!

🎁 BONUS: Invite a friend to get +1,000 CASH!
